title: Greenini
tagline: Carbon emissions is an urgent concern today. Greenini plans to incentivize reducing emissions.
description: Greenini helps corporations or organizations to spin up carbon emission reduction incentivazation programs. These programs can run intra-company, and the tokens generated by the platform in these intra-company competiitons could enable inter-company carbon credit trading. It is made using solidity smart contracts and inteneds to use Account Abstraction to enable employees to utilize Ethereum without having to learn anything about it.
how_its_made:
Solidity smart contracts have been used, truffle has been used to create integration steps for the smart contracts. The App also has a simple UI that allows to set up carbon emission reduction competiitons.

We tried integrating several pratners including Flow - where we tried deploying on their EVM compatible test networks.
